title: [Dataverse] Use Truncate for CRM Integration Record cleanup during environment copy
summary: Environment copy cleanup of CRM Integration Records now uses bulk truncate instead of row-by-row deletion to improve performance on large coupling tables, with fallback to the original DeleteAll method when truncate is unsupported.
key_points: Switches CleanCDSIntegration from DeleteAll() to Record.Truncate() for faster bulk cleanup
Falls back to DeleteAll only when truncate is unsupported (delete-event subscriber or security filter present)
Preserves ChangeCompany scoping and OnBeforeCleanCRMIntegrationRecords hook behavior
Optimizes TableKey.DisableAll to run only on slow fallback path
Adds comprehensive test coverage for truncate, fallback, and ChangeCompany scenarios
